name: Hungarian Parliament Building
description: A neo-Gothic riverside parliament dominates the Danube bank with a central dome.

name: Buda Castle
description: Palace wings and museums crown Castle Hill above the Danube.

name: Fisherman’s Bastion
description: Turreted terraces look across to Pest and Parliament from Castle Hill.

name: St. Stephen’s Basilica
description: Budapest’s largest church offers a dome panorama over the city.

name: Esztergom Basilica
description: Hungary’s largest church rises above the Danube bend near the Slovak border.

name: Danube Bend
description: River curves, hills and castle ruins north of Budapest make a classic day trip.

name: Lake Balaton
description: Central Europe’s large lake draws summer beaches, wine hills and ferry hops.

name: Szeged Dóm Square
description: An arcaded square frames the Votive Church in Hungary’s southern university city.

name: Aggtelek Caves
description: Karst caves shared with Slovakia, including the Baradla system.

name: Hortobágy National Park
description: Puszta grasslands with traditional herds and a Nine-Arch Bridge landmark.

name: Great Market Hall
description: A vast market by Freedom Bridge sells paprika, produce and upstairs snack counters.

name: Kazinczy Street ruin bars
description: Courtyard ruin pubs in District VII serve drinks and street snacks in mismatched décor.

name: Debrecen market
description: Eastern Hungary’s hub offers markets and restaurants around the Great Church.

name: Pécs cafés & markets
description: A southern city with Mediterranean-leaning cafés near the mosque-church square.

name: Tokaj wine cellars
description: Historic cellars in the Tokaj region pour sweet and dry wines from UNESCO vineyards.

name: Sziget Festival
description: A large multi-genre music festival on Óbuda Island each August.
